natural: native greedy generation; original max64/EOS/cache settings
fixed16: native generate min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens=16; separate performance protocol
decode: fresh prefill, fixed baseline first token, q=1 s=T+1; prefill outside timed boundary
timing: preloaded GPU inputs -> native generate/decode return + CUDA synchronize; excludes processor/H2D/I/O/scoring/model load/profiler/external hooks
cuda_event: auxiliary stream elapsed including device idle between dependent launches; not pure kernel sum
memory: after sync record start allocated and reset peaks; absolute max allocated primary; increment/reserved separate; no empty_cache in timed blocks
empty_cache_policy: never empty_cache; separate fresh process per configuration/phase; allocator warmed twice per sample
anchors: baseline diagnostic 2 samples at beginning/end, same warmups/reps; >10% median wall change triggers inspection and paired repeat
flops: major matrix/conv multiply-add=2; elementwise/transcendentals/data movement separate; actual G and standardized G*=16
learning_nodes: skip per explicit user request; no personal mastery assertion
